title: Mothership: A Two Tier Autonomous Refuse Collection System for Pedestrian Campuses
description:
arXiv:2610.22461v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Refuse collection in pedestrian campuses, parks and mixed-use districts remains manual because compaction trucks cannot reach bins located on walkways, courtyards and building service doors.
